name: open_hem_checks_out
why: ENTRY GP18, the fourth operation. An open hem 10 long with gap 1 on the edge at the end of the 50 leg of the L. Measured with the bench probe (`probe0089 hem`) before writing it: the open one is the formula of the flange with the bend at 180 degrees and the inner radius equal to half the gap — three measurements out of three to the thousandth (gap 1 and 2, length 10 and 15).

expect.tolerance_why: (10 - 0.5 - 2) + pi * (0.5 + 0.5 * 2) - (0.5 + 2) = 9.712 mm of extra flat pattern, over 2 x 40. Measured 776.99
